issues.title: OpenRAC may encounter a very obscure but guaranteed crash from base RaC1
issues.author: TheWhiteGuardian
issues.body:
Hello OpenRAC team! I want to congratulate you all on this amazing project.
I've been messing with the memory of RaC1 for fun, using PCSX2 and RPCS3, for some time now. In doing so I've discovered a quirk about planet Quartu that, under the right circumstances, can guaranteed crash the game. I've tested OpenRAC and it also crashes when it encounters this scenario.
